title: Design System: Rodrigo Gomes — 1986 Miami Night

script.purpose: The first name only, in the hero lockup and the Contact neon sign. Never used elsewhere.

display.purpose: Titles, big numbers, the toast stamp; always outlined white with a hard drop. Never body copy.

hud.purpose: Numerals and short readouts only: clock, stat counts, tuner years, career dates, package figures. Tabular-nums, no panel.

body.purpose: Everything read: claims, notes, entries, labels, UI copy.

micro.purpose: Frame-corner labels, group labels, plate/uppercase tags.

lead.purpose: Career org titles, note text, entry note emphasis.

email.purpose: The Contact section's large email readout.

shadows.name: frame-shadow
shadows.purpose: The ambient lift under every menu frame (.frame::before), the pause-menu bar and its mobile overlay panel.

shadows.name: glow-pink
shadows.value: text-shadow with color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-brand) 55%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Behind the script signature, the Contact neon sign, the toast stamp, the entry sun-slice.

shadows.name: glow-cyan
shadows.value: text-shadow / box-shadow with color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-added) 50%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Behind the HUD clock, tuner LCD digits, the Packages download-share bar.

shadows.name: action-shadow
shadows.purpose: Small ambient lift under filled .action buttons; dropped on .action-ghost.

shadows.name: target-mark
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--c-select); outline-offset: 6px, animated over 1.8s
shadows.purpose: Transient permalink highlight on :target entries; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The system-wide ease: scene fade-in, toast stamp, tuner diff-line motion, action/nav hover.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Action/nav hover, dial hover, diff-line strike.

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Floor-grid fade under the cheat code, nav underline reveal.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Reserved slow tier for larger state changes (e.g. scene layer cross-fades).

motion.name: glitch-hover
motion.purpose: The signature chromatic glitch: fires only on hover of the hero name lockup, cyan/pink channel split plus a clip-path flicker; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: scene-live-fade
motion.purpose: The live WebGL canvas fading in over the SVG poster once its first frame is ready.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Tightest phone tier: stat/lockup sizes step down, notes stack to one column.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Grid collapses to 1 column; package table drops registry/version columns; career stops stack.

breakpoints.name: hero-band
breakpoints.purpose: Hero scene becomes a height-bound band with the HUD moved beside the sun; Stack layout collapses to 1 column.

breakpoints.name: menu-fold
breakpoints.purpose: Pause-menu nav folds behind the compact MENU toggle (src/scripts/menu.ts).

adaptive: paused offscreen and on hidden tabs
adaptive quality that freezes on slow machines
WebGL context-loss handled, SVG poster always underneath as fallback
scenePerformanceBudget.purpose: src/scripts/scene.ts: the one raw-WebGL fragment shader (no library) carrying the sky, sliced sun, stars, horizon glow, ocean shimmer and the cheat-code grid.

easterEgg.effect: swaps the hero scene's floor to the owner's original vaporwave perspective grid (vaporwave tokens in src/design/tokens.ts) and shows a small 'CHEAT ACTIVATED' Orbitron line for ~2.4s
easterEgg.scope: hero scene only; does not change the site-wide palette or navigation

components.name: Primary action (Email me)
components.description: Filled brand-pink CTA in the display face, 3px dark-outline border, no lift on hover — only a color swap to the selection green.
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding-inline: 24px; border: 3px solid #05010F; border-radius: 10px; background: #FF6EC7; color: #1A0526; font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.1875rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1rem -0.5rem rgba(0,0,0,0.7); transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: #00FF97; color: #04140C; box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1rem -0.5rem rgba(0,0,0,0.7); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #00FF97; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost action (GitHub / LinkedIn)
components.description: Transparent secondary action sharing the action geometry, no ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-action-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding-inline: 24px; border: 3px solid #3A2C72; border-radius: 10px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #0E0826 70%, transparent); color: #FFF6FB; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action-ghost:hover { background: #00FF97; color: #04140C; }

components.name: Plate — Role (hero note)
components.description: Plain-noun role plate, sun-yellow fill, set in the HUD face, uppercase.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding-inline: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #FFEA00; color: #1A1400; font-family: Orbitron, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Menu frame (signature panel)
components.description: The console-menu frame: thick dark border, 14deg-corner tilt on the backdrop only, an inset hairline and an ambient drop shadow. Used for the AI-workflow method, the Compare tuner, work/open-source/package entries and the 404 card.
components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; isolation: isolate; padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 48px); } .ds-frame::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border: 4px solid #05010F; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, #BD00FF 10%, transparent), transparent 40%), #1C1440; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #3A2C72, 0 1.25rem 2.5rem -1rem rgba(0,0,0,0.7); transform: rotate(-0.5deg); } .ds-frame-label { font-family: Orbitron, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FF6EC7; } .ds-frame-title { font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #FFF6FB; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.14em #0B0620; paint-order: stroke fill; }

components.name: HUD readout (no panel)
components.description: An icon and an outlined, role-colored Orbitron number floating directly over the scene: the live clock and the hero stat counters (stars, downloads, contributions), each linking to its proof. Hover swaps the whole readout to the selection-green pill.
components.css: .ds-hud { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; color: #00D9FF; } .ds-hud:hover { background: #00FF97; color: #04140C; } .ds-hud-n { font-family: Orbitron, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.375rem; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.2em #0B0620; paint-order: stroke fill; } .ds-hud:hover .ds-hud-n { -webkit-text-stroke: 0; }

components.name: Pause menu (site header nav)
components.description: Sticky floating menu-frame bar: pink script handle, plain-noun links in outlined Luckiest Guy, current/hover on the selection-green bar; folds behind a MENU toggle under 70rem.
components.html:
rodrigogs
WorkCareer
components.css: .ds-menu { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 52px; padding-inline: 16px 8px; border: 3px solid #05010F; border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #1C1440 94%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 1.25rem 2.5rem -1rem rgba(0,0,0,0.7); } .ds-handle { color: #FF6EC7; font-family: Yellowtail, cursive; font-size: 1.625rem; text-decoration: none; text-shadow: 0 0 0.35em color-mix(in srgb, #FF6EC7 55%, transparent); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding-inline: 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #FF6EC7; font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='true'] { background: #00FF97; color: #04140C; }

components.name: Compare tuner dial
components.description: The signature interaction's LCD-strip year dial (prev/next arrows either side), Orbitron digits in cyan with a cyan glow, disabled by default so the server-rendered diff reads with JS off.
components.css: .ds-dial { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0,1fr) 44px; border: 3px solid #05010F; border-radius: 10px; background: #06101F; overflow: hidden; } .ds-step { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 48px; border: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, #00D9FF 16%, #06101F); color: #00D9FF; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step:hover { background: #00FF97; color: #04140C; } .ds-year { display: grid; place-items: center; color: #00D9FF; font-family: Orbitron, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.625rem; font-weight: 800; text-shadow: 0 0 0.4em color-mix(in srgb, #00D9FF 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Toast stamp (Email copied)
components.description: Full-viewport unboxed stamp: giant skewed pink outlined display title with an Orbitron subtitle, on a soft radial dusk (not a box). The signature copy-confirmation moment.
components.html:
EMAIL COPIED!

rodrigo@example.com IS ON YOUR CLIPBOARD
components.css: .ds-toast { display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 12px; text-align: center; background: radial-gradient(50% 34% at 50% 50%, color-mix(in srgb, #0E0826 78%, transparent), transparent 100%); } .ds-toast-title { color: #FF6EC7; font-family: 'Luckiest Guy', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 1rem + 7vw, 6rem); text-transform: uppercase; transform: skewX(-10deg); text-shadow: 0.06em 0.07em 0 #0B0620, 0 0 0.3em color-mix(in srgb, #FF6EC7 55%, transparent); } .ds-toast-sub { color: #FFF6FB; font-family: Orbitron, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(0.8125rem, 0.7rem + 0.5vw, 1rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; -webkit-text-stroke: 0.3em #0B0620; paint-order: stroke fill; }

narrative.northStar: The Pause Menu Over the Sunset
narrative.overview:
The site is a night drive through 1986 Miami: a live WebGL sunset over the ocean, palm and Art Deco silhouettes, and the real work — proof, numbers, a career, a stack — laid over it as a console-menu UI, an owner-pinned homage to the era's console crime games (PRODUCT.md, 'Pinned aesthetic'). It is a brief-pinned world, not a rolled one: every neon color, both display faces, the menu-frame geometry and the green selection bar existed as a decision before the build and now exist as shipped tokens in src/design/tokens.ts, read by the CSS, the WebGL shader, and the GitHub-profile README card renderer alike, so the site and the README cannot drift apart.

The system draws a hard line between two registers. The scene and its frame furniture are unapologetically game-menu: a brush-script signature, an outlined display face with a hard drop, HUD numerals with no panel, thick-bordered tilted frames, a radio tuner, a toast stamp, scanlines, and a chromatic glitch that fires on hover. The content read as prose — every claim about the person — stays plain: Role, Product, AI, Work, Open source, Packages, Career, Stack, Contact are literal professional nouns, never changelog or game jargon. Game vocabulary is UI flavor only (a toast, a cheat, a tuner), never a claim about him. One color, a synthetic green (#00FF97) absent from the vaporwave four, is the single selection state across the whole system: every hover, focus ring, and current nav item uses it and nothing else, exactly as the pause menus it pays homage to use one highlight color.

Homage, not copy is load-bearing, not decorative: no Rockstar/Take-Two marks, no 'Grand Theft Auto'/'Vice City' branding, no game art, no extracted game fonts (Pricedown's license forbids webfont embedding), no radio names or audio. Every shape (the tilted menu frame, the sliced-sun scene, the four typefaces, the icon set) is drawn from the site's own SVG, shader and font choices.
keyCharacteristics: One selection color (#00FF97) for every hover, focus and current-item state; no other color plays that role.
Four faces, four jobs: Yellowtail script (the name only), Luckiest Guy outlined display (titles, big numbers, never body), Inter (everything read), Orbitron (HUD numerals and readouts, no panel).
Menu frames are thick dark-bordered panels tilted +/-0.5deg like a framed postcard; HUD readouts float with no panel at all -- an icon plus an outlined colored number.
A single 4px spacing unit; every block snaps to a whole step (--s-1...--s-11).
Plain professional nouns label the person; game vocabulary (toast, cheat, tuner, 'STATION') stays confined to UI flavor on the signature interactions, never to a section heading or a claim about him.

rules.name: The One Selection Color Rule
rules.body: #00FF97 (green) is the only hover, focus-visible and current-item color anywhere in the system. Every :hover, :focus-visible and [aria-current]/[data-current] state resolves to this one color, never to brand pink or any role color, as in the menus this world pays homage to.

rules.name: The Outline Rule
rules.body: Every display-face title and every HUD numeral carries a heavy dark outline (-webkit-text-stroke in var(--outline)) with paint-order: stroke fill, so white or neon type stays legible directly over the scene with no background panel underneath it.

rules.name: The HUD-Has-No-Panel Rule
rules.body: HUD readouts (the clock, the stat counters, the tuner digits) are never set inside a bordered panel or card. They are an icon and an outlined colored number floating straight over the scene or the night.

rules.name: The No-Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Nothing translates, scales, or gains a new shadow on hover or focus. State change is color-only, to the one selection green, matching the menu-select behavior this world pays homage to.

dos: Do keep #00FF97 (green) as the only hover/focus/current-item color across the whole system; a new surface reuses it before reaching for any other state color.
Do hold Yellowtail to the name only, Luckiest Guy to titles/numbers/the toast (always outlined + hard drop, never body copy), Inter to everything read, and Orbitron to numerals and readouts only.

Do label anything describing the person with a plain professional noun (Role, Product, AI, Work, Open source, Packages, Career, Stack, Contact); confine game vocabulary (toast, cheat, tuner, 'STATION') to UI flavor on the signature interactions, never to a section heading or a claim about him.
Do set HUD readouts with no panel -- an icon and an outlined colored number straight over the scene or the night.

Do keep the scene's performance budget: hero JS under 5KB gzip, no three.js/bloom/ray-marching/particles, capped DPR, paused offscreen/hidden-tab, a still frame under reduced motion, and WebGL context loss handled by falling back to the always-present SVG poster.
Do snap every block to the 4px spacing scale (--s-1...--s-11); nothing in the build uses an off-scale spacing value.
donts: Don't use a second color for hover, focus, or 'current' state; every such state resolves to the one selection green.

Don't apply changelog vocabulary ('Now', 'Unreleased', CalVer dates, 'Latest' plates) to the person -- this is a Miami-night console world, not a release ledger, and that jargon was already rejected once for a prior world; it does not belong in this one either.

Don't add a hard-offset neobrutalist box-shadow anywhere; the 'hard drop' that exists on display titles and the toast stamp is a text-shadow on the display/HUD faces specifically, pinned by the direction contract -- it is not a general-purpose shadow device for new components.

Don't promote a frame's corner label ('STATION') into a kicker/eyebrow sitting above a SectionHead title; it belongs to the menu-frame furniture, never to the section-heading pattern (which stays one literal noun, then one claim sentence, no label above it).

Don't use Rockstar/Take-Two marks, the words 'Grand Theft Auto' or 'Vice City' as branding, game art or screenshots, fonts extracted from the game (Pricedown is never webfont-embedded), or radio station names/audio; this world is built only from its own SVG, shader and font choices.
Don't lift, scale, or add a new shadow on hover; state change is color-only.
